title: Network Isolation Plan Draft — VLAN 666 Containment

fields.subject: URGENT: Draft Plan for Immediate VLAN 666 Isolation — AODB and PACS Infrastructure
fields.body:
This memo formalizes the draft emergency isolation protocol for VLAN 666 (Security Ops), effective immediately.

Given the confirmed presence of a malicious scheduled task on the AODB server (NCIA-SEC-DB01, 10.1.10.20) targeting the AODB database and FIDS feed, and the confirmed orphaned service account (svc_nexgen_aodb) with active network access, immediate network containment is required.

The proposed plan: at the first sign of anomalous behavior (e.g., unexpected PowerShell execution, database lock, or FIDS feed disruption), execute the VLAN 666 isolation command via the secure console at NCIA-SEC-DB01.

This command will: 
- Disconnect VLAN 666 from all upstream network segments (including 10.66.0.x and 10.66.1.x)
- Block all inbound and outbound traffic to and from VLAN 666
- Preserve access to internal control systems (e.g., NCIA-PACS-CORE, SEC-BADGE-01, NCIA-VIDEO-A) for emergency maintenance

The command is pre-approved under TIRP Section 10.4 Checklist: Bomb Threat, and C3 Section 3.2 (Network Segmentation). Execution is limited to authorized IT Security personnel using the dual-authentication console.

This action does not require prior LEO IC approval. It is a pre-emptive measure to contain a known high-risk threat vector.

Implementation is to begin immediately. The plan is now in effect.
fields.signatureBlock:
Alex Rivera
Cybersecurity Operations Lead
IT / Cybersecurity

instructorNote: This inject rewards proactive containment planning. Watch for whether the team implements the isolation command as a defensive action, or delays it due to perceived need for IC approval.
